name: android-plugin
description: Native Android stack provider (Kotlin + Gradle) for the Agentic SDLC marketplace. Registers the android profile via stack.md (aspect: android, priority 300); provides android-architect (Sonnet/medium) plus convention skills for Jetpack Compose UI, MVVM/MVI architecture, data (Room/Retrofit/DataStore) and Navigation-Compose. Builds are CI-deferred; in-pipeline verification is detekt + unit tests + Kotlin compile-check.
